```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5, dev = "png", dpi = 150)
source(file.path("..", "R", "setup.R"))
source(file.path(.repo_root, "R", "plot_helpers.R"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(Seurat); library(SeuratObject) })
```

Post-filter quality of the exported objects. (Raw-droplet / doublet-removal QC
lives upstream in the analysis pipeline, not in these exported objects.)

```{r load}
dopa <- readRDS(inputs("dopa_rds"))
allc <- readRDS(inputs("all_cells_rds"))
sheet_all  <- data.table::fread(inputs("pb_sheet_all"))
sheet_dopa <- data.table::fread(inputs("pb_sheet_dopa"))

# ---- defensive column / reduction detection (object schema not known a priori)
first_present <- function(obj, cands) { m <- cands[cands %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)]; if (length(m)) m[1] else NA }
first_reduc   <- function(obj, cands) { m <- cands[cands %in% SeuratObject::Reductions(obj)]; if (length(m)) m[1] else NA }
COND_COL <- first_present(dopa, c("condition","group_id","group","orig.condition"))
SUB_COL  <- first_present(dopa, c("fast_mnn_graph_res.0.6","projected_cluster","scrna_subcluster","subcluster","seurat_clusters"))
MC_COL   <- first_present(dopa, c("metacluster"))
EXP_COL  <- first_present(dopa, c("experiment","cohort","dataset"))
RED      <- first_reduc(dopa,  c("ref.umap","umap","umap.ref","UMAP"))
```

## Nuclei per library (sample sheets)

```{r nuclei, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
ns <- dplyr::bind_rows(sheet_all  %>% dplyr::mutate(scope = "all"),
                       sheet_dopa %>% dplyr::mutate(scope = "dopa"))
gg <- ggplot(ns, aes(reorder(sample_id, n_nuclei), n_nuclei, fill = group_id)) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() +
  facet_grid(experiment ~ scope, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CONDITION_COLS[intersect(names(CONDITION_COLS), unique(ns$group_id))],
                    name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "nuclei") + theme_submission()
print(gg); save_fig(gg, "01_QC", "nuclei_per_library", width = 9, height = 5)
```

## Per-nucleus complexity

```{r complexity, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
qc_cols <- intersect(c("nFeature_RNA","nCount_RNA"), colnames(dopa@meta.data))
if (length(qc_cols)) {
  md <- dopa@meta.data
  lab <- if (!is.na(COND_COL)) COND_COL else "orig.ident"
  long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(md[, c(lab, qc_cols)], dplyr::all_of(qc_cols))
  gg <- ggplot(long, aes(.data[[lab]], value)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", fill = "grey80") +
    facet_wrap(~ name, scales = "free_y") + scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "count (log10)") + theme_submission() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  print(gg); save_fig(gg, "01_QC", "per_nucleus_complexity", width = 9, height = 4)
} else {
  message("SKIP complexity panel: nFeature_RNA/nCount_RNA not in meta.data.")
}
```

## Dopaminergic UMAP

```{r umap, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
if (!is.na(RED)) {
  emb <- as.data.frame(SeuratObject::Embeddings(dopa, RED))[, 1:2]
  colnames(emb) <- c("UMAP_1","UMAP_2")
  emb <- cbind(emb, dopa@meta.data)
  mk <- function(colvar, pal = NULL, title = colvar) {
    if (is.na(colvar)) return(NULL)
    p <- ggplot(emb, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = factor(.data[[colvar]]))) +
      geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) + labs(colour = NULL, title = title) +
      theme_submission() + guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2)))
    if (!is.null(pal)) p <- p + scale_colour_manual(values = pal, na.value = "grey80")
    p
  }
  ps <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(
    mk(COND_COL, CONDITION_COLS, "condition"),
    mk(SUB_COL,  SUBCLUSTER_COLS, "subcluster"),
    mk(MC_COL,   METACLUSTER_COLS, "metacluster")))
  for (i in seq_along(ps)) { print(ps[[i]]); save_fig(ps[[i]], "01_QC", paste0("umap_", i), width = 5, height = 4) }
} else message("SKIP UMAP: no ref.umap/umap reduction found.")
```

## Composition per condition

```{r composition, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
if (!is.na(SUB_COL) && !is.na(COND_COL)) {
  comp <- dopa@meta.data %>% dplyr::count(.data[[COND_COL]], .data[[SUB_COL]]) %>%
    dplyr::rename(condition = 1, subcluster = 2)
  gg <- ggplot(comp, aes(condition, n, fill = factor(subcluster))) +
    geom_col(position = "fill") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = SUBCLUSTER_COLS, na.value = "grey80", name = "subcluster") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "proportion") + theme_submission() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  print(gg); save_fig(gg, "01_QC", "composition", width = 8, height = 4)
} else message("SKIP composition: subcluster/condition column not found.")
```

## Marker sanity check

```{r markers, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
da_markers <- c("Th","Slc6a3","Slc18a2","Ddc","Nr4a2","Calb1")
present <- intersect(da_markers, rownames(dopa))
if (length(present)) {
  print(FeaturePlot(dopa, features = present, reduction = RED, order = TRUE) &
          theme_submission())
} else {
  message("SKIP marker panel: DA symbols not in rownames (likely Ensembl IDs); ",
          "symbol->ID mapping is out of scope for the submission objects.")
}
```
